title: A Woman with a Knife or A Knife with a Woman? Measuring Directional Bias Amplification in Image Captions

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring directional bias amplification (DBAC) by masking gender-revealing tokens, aligning vocabulary using contextual substitution, and training an attacker model to predict ground-truth gender from both human-generated and model-generated image captions.
